text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe on Sunday signed a $6 billion agreement with a Malaysian company for the privatisation and expansion of the southern African country's Hwange Thermal Power Station.

- Developing countries will have difficulties in advancing the use of solar energy unless developed states commit themselves to providing the much needed support, Malaysian prime minister Dr Mahathir Mohammad said on Sunday.

- The first phase of a proposed $5 billion housing project, which is part of a national scheme launched as a joint venture between Zimbabwe and Malaysia is set to start in Zimbabwe's southwestern city of Bulawayo in the next two months, with the construction of 10,000 low-cost housing units.
